> What is the probability this person will complete this task by 2050, and a distant being with much higher general intelligence will want to know?

These are two independent questions.

First we ask about this person's probability of completing this task during this lifetime. If compute power is limited this is strongly 0, and requires immeasurableness of time. If there are no limits to computing power then the task could be completed if the task consumes reasonable proportions of computing power, but the question of whether this matters remains open, though the universe is sufficently large that we should expect that when we see evidence of intelligence where that intelligence wishes it to be the case the task should end.㭕사용자
